profile.Civilian Name: Adrian Koh; Xǔ Jùn Háo (许俊豪)
profile.Guardian Appearance: Lotus wears a dark blue and white Guardian uniform with flowing patterns inspired by water and lotus petals. His outfit incorporates subtle green accents reflecting Verdant's inherited Earth magic. His transformation gives his hair a deep blue sheen and his eyes a clearer, water-like appearance. The lotus pendant remains visible at his chest.
profile.Signature Ability: Planned — Lotus Blessing; Lotus specialises in enhancing and protecting allies through Water magic supported by inherited Earth energy. His abilities include creating fast-moving magical currents that increase movement speed, reinforcing allies with flexible defensive layers, and controlling blood loss through precise fluid manipulation and accelerated natural clotting. Rather than focusing on direct combat or complete healing, his magic supports mobility, survival, and emergency stabilisation.
profile.Strengths: Speed enhancement, defensive buffs, bleeding control, Water manipulation, emergency stabilisation, battlefield support, adaptability, and teamwork.
profile.Weaknesses: Adrian may underestimate danger because of his relaxed attitude. Maintaining buffs on multiple allies consumes significant energy and concentration. His speed enhancements require careful control to prevent loss of balance, while his bleeding control cannot repair major injuries or replace dedicated healing magic.
profile.Fear: Discovering that his powers were deliberately given to him for someone else's purposes, especially if using them could unintentionally endanger people he cares about.
profile.Mentor: Luma Flora; Luma Blossom, Luma Tidal are not officially registered.
profile.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Aster (Amelia Chua).
profile.Close bonds: Luma Aster (Amelia); later the other members of Wildflowers. Flower Sisters
profile.Loves: Peaceful company, meaningful relationships, quiet moments, and spending time with people who make him feel comfortable.
profile.Likes: Relaxed conversations, light teasing, tea, peaceful environments, observing nature, and spending time near water.
profile.Dislikes: Unnecessary arguments, excessive drama, being pressured into decisions, and people making situations more complicated than necessary.
profile.Hates: Manipulation, exploitation, deliberately harming innocent people, and abusing the trust of others.
profile.Hobbies: Reading, swimming, visiting cafés, casual gaming, listening to music, and taking peaceful walks.
profile.Personality: Adrian is calm, easygoing, and observant, with a dry sense of humour and a naturally relaxed personality. He is friendly without being overly talkative and is comfortable sharing quiet moments without feeling the need to fill every silence. Although he generally avoids unnecessary conflict, he is dependable when situations become serious and approaches problems with patience and practical thinking. Adrian enjoys lightly teasing people he is close to, often delivering amusing remarks with a completely composed expression. His calm nature complements Amelia's gentle and cautious personality, allowing her to feel comfortable without pressure. Despite his seemingly carefree attitude, he takes the wellbeing of others seriously and gradually develops a strong sense of responsibility as he learns more about his Guardian abilities.
Personality Example: When Amelia begins worrying about a difficult training exercise, Adrian calmly helps her work through the problem instead of simply telling her not to worry. He stays beside her until she feels ready to try again.
When someone makes an exaggerated complaint, Adrian responds with a perfectly serious expression and a dry remark, making it difficult to tell whether he is joking.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Adrian becomes noticeably more insecure and emotionally vulnerable when feverish. He tends to overthink others' actions, worrying that he is being a burden or that they are only caring for him out of obligation. He frequently seeks reassurance, particularly from Amelia, but struggles to ask for it directly. He becomes unusually sensitive to being left alone and may quietly question whether others genuinely care about him.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Adrian becomes extremely sleepy when intoxicated, often dozing off regardless of where he is or what is happening around him. He grows noticeably quieter and less responsive, occasionally falling asleep in the middle of conversations. He may unconsciously lean against whoever is nearby, particularly Amelia, and becomes difficult to wake once he has fallen asleep.
profile.Core Idea of character: A Guardian awakened through deception who chooses his own path.
Quotes: "I don't know why I have these powers. But I know what I want to do with them."
profile.Background:
In 2026, while his Core was still dormant, Adrian was approached by Blightyou, who introduced himself as a researcher and persuaded him to visit his lair. There, Adrian encountered Luma Verdant, whom Blightyou falsely described as a fellow researcher who was ill and quarantined. Unknown to Adrian, Verdant was actually being held captive, and she awakened his Core during his visit, leaving Earth power within his natural Water magic.
Adrian left without knowing he had been awakened. A few days later, he encountered Luma Aster and attempted to imitate her healing abilities, unexpectedly discovering that he could use magic himself. Believing his powers had appeared spontaneously, he was later registered by Luma Umbra as Self-Awakened, although his true awakening was performed by Verdant.
When Blossom and EmberFlora encountered Lotus, their Cores reacted faintly to the familiar Earth signature within his magic. Both recognised its similarity to Verdant's power, placing them on high alert about his unexplained awakening.
Adrian eventually begins training under Flora and develops abilities centred around controlled water, healing, barriers, and battlefield support. He joins Wildflowers and grows particularly close to Amelia, whose gentle personality complements his calm nature. Their friendship eventually develops into romance.
